**Deletion test and Production check.** Deleting the one-use [plan conversion function](/Users/cooper/Projects/bundjil/packages/infrastructure/scripts/report-drift.ts:423) would merely move its logic into its caller, not remove complexity. Deleting the report module would push classification into the command. Neither is a useful refactor by itself.
